0.evidence_source: Quote: "After giving informed consent, participants completed a paperand-pencil questionnaire on campus in a group setting, supervised by members of the research team."
0._section_summary: This section describes procedures for a single study conducted with college students recruited from a university participant pool who completed a paper-and-pencil questionnaire in supervised group sessions on campus. Measures included body image, body modification, risk behaviors/attitudes, and mental health; participants received course credit and responses were anonymous. The study received IRB approval; no study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') is provided in the text.
